name: Engineering Discipline
description: Core engineering workflow discipline: brainstorming-first design, step-by-step execution plans, test-driven development (TDD), systematic root-cause debugging, and verification before completion.
description_zh: 核心工程纪律工作流：包含先设计后实现、分步执行计划、测试驱动开发（TDD）、系统化根因调试与完成前实证校验。
